lines: Having removed youth ocean wave burden; having mounted renunciation boat firmly by force; who having obtained devotion ascent with Maheśa thought gems crushes indeed those dangers of saṃsāra.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tāruṇyasāgarataraṅgabharānapohya vairāgyapotamadhiruhya dṛḍhaṃ haṭhena yo bhaktirohaṇamavāpya maheśacintāratnairalaṃ dalayati sma bhavāpadastāḥ
